We have template 1679747. Need to propose retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2. That's a stilbene derivative with two anisole (methoxy phenyl) groups attached to a central double bond (trans? but not specified). The template appears to be a retro reaction that breaks a double bond and forms a silyl group and Li? Let's examine the retro_smarts_template: '[CH2;D1;+0:1]=[C;H0;D3;+0:2](-[c:3])-[c:4]>>C-[Si](-C)(-C)-[CH2;D2;+0:1]-[Li].O=[C;H0;D3;+0:2](-[c:3])-[c:4]'

So forward reaction: C-[Si](-C)(-C)-CH2-Li + O= C( ... ) -> alkene product. Retro: from alkene product to silyl carbanion and carbonyl? Actually retro: product (alkene) -> reagents: a silyl group attached to CH2-Li (i.e., a silyl-stabilized carbanion) and a carbonyl (aldehyde/ketone) attached to aromatic ring.

Thus applying this template retrosynthetically to our target should give two precursors: a silyl-stabilized carbanion (maybe Me3Si-CH2-Li) and a carbonyl aromatic compound (anisaldehyde?). Let's apply template to target using apply_template tool.
